quest.title: Cooking, the Flavor of Nature
quest.description: You received a commission from Arapacati in Vanarana to help look for her brothers who are practicing cooking. Do as Arapacati says and look for the rising pillars of smoke.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Recipe: Mushroom Hodgepodge x1

talks.objective: Look for a rising pillar of smoke

dialogues.text: *whimper*
Aah! It's Nara.
*cough* I'm sorry that Nara had to see me in such a messy state.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Kind Nara, I'm Arachatora. You are?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon's name is Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, I see. Thank you so much. If fate hadn't brought us together, it would have taken me much longer to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How long is a little longer?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: I'm ashamed to admit that something like this happened once before because of bad mushrooms. The Nilotpala Lotuses in the water bloomed and closed, twice, before I recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bloomed and closed... Doesn't that take two days!?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Ah, two days. I see, so that's what a day means. You Nara are really interesting. Are two days long or short?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Is it long or short?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, Paimon can't imagine how Arachatora whimpered for two days straight.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Really? So it's a very long time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if you're Arachatora... Aren't you related to Arapacati?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But... You're Arapacati's older brother, right?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Oh, how did you know? Arapacati is my "younger sister."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is confused...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Perhaps it's different for Aranara...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let us bring you up to speed...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You bring Arachatora up to speed on the events so far...

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Festival Utsava is coming again... What should I do...

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: I haven't had the most important cooking ingredient yet. Festival Utsava should be the best time to prove the greatness of mushroom dishes to Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Aras... spa... ara...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhh! Aranara names are so difficult! Arachatora, where're your brothers?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: We drifted apart on our paths of training, just like a river branches into streams.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you split apart, right?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: We train to cook the supreme delicacy, but they refuse to acknowledge mushroom dishes — how could they not see that the Head Mushroom is unmatched!

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Anyway, we decided to complete our own dishes and compete with each other later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon totally understands the pursuit of delicious food!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, where's your Head Mushroom?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Marana has been spreading rapidly. Even the Head Mushroom's habitat has been taken over.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, the Withering Zone... Paimon hopes Rana is doing okay.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Its withering claws have probably taken the precious mushroom there. I'm sure you're aware how very, very dangerous Marana's territory is.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Without the Head Mushroom, I could only try the strange mushroom that no Aranara has ever tasted before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And?

choices.text: And we witnessed the outcome of it.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: How embarrassing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, The Withering... Uh, Marana... We've dealt with it before, right?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Whoa, unbelievable! You can fight Marana.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #Well, it does make sense. Since Nara {NICKNAME} could heal me with the power of Lesser Lord Kusanali, then removing the effect of Marana shouldn't be a problem.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #So, I want to ask Nara {NICKNAME} to come with me to the Head Mushroom's habitat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's our chance to taste an extremely delicious mushroom dish! {NICKNAME}, let's help him, so that these siblings can get back together!

choices.text: We did give Arapacati our word.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Alright, it's in the cave ahead. Please come with me.

choices.text: You're just doing it for the food.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're killing two birds with one stone! What's wrong with that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... True. Come to think of it, we've known each other for a long time, but it feels like we met just yesterday.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Really? That's relieving. So losing control for two days in the forest isn't very long.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not what we meant!

choices.text: It depends on what the time was used for.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... that's true. Two whole days of whimpering is very long, but two whole days in a forest boar's life is very short.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Really? So it's a very long time...

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #Yes, Nara {NICKNAME}, you understand the principles of the forest well. To the forest, life is born, life grows, and life returns to the earth... All these don't need such concept as a "day."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're not making much sense to Paimon...

talks.objective: Use Dendro to heal the Aranara

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Ahh! The Head Mushroom I've always been dreaming about.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Head Mushroom, would you still be the same without your sweet scent?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... This mushroom does smell really good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's get out!

talks.objective: Use Dendro to heal the Aranara

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: I'm so lucky to have met both of you.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: It's the smell of a fully matured Head Mushroom. It's richer than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: So, you grew well even when Marana took over your habitat. You're amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, so... Can we taste it?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Of course. Putting aside how you've helped me, serving the most delicious mushroom dish to Nara again has always been the goal of my cooking training.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! Head Mushroom!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Arachatora immediately starts cooking...\nThe fresh aroma of the mushroom bursts out from the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Once it's ready, Arachatora serves it to you and Paimon.\nShould it be considered disappointing? Or conforming to expectations? Because it's tasteless.\nBesides that, it's filled with vitality and too tough to the point of being difficult to chew.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: ...It's done. My cooking training has finally been completed successfully. What do you think? I'm sure it's the best delicacy to a Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *nom nom* *gulp* Uh... how should Paimon put this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *chew forcefully*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *swallow forcefully*

choices.text: It's edible. If you try hard enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... It's a very fragrant mushroom indeed, but its texture and taste don't really suit us.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #How could this be? When I served it to the other Nara from before, {F#he}{M#she} said it was good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From before?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #I served my mushroom dish to a Nara some time ago, and because it was so good, {F#he}{M#she} swallowed it with so much vigor.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: It should be fine.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Oh, just like every Aranara grows different leaves, the taste of the mushroom may not suit all Nara.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right... Speaking of leaves... Are Aranara not afraid of fire? You look like you're covered in leaves...

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Of course it's scary. Forest fires sometimes raze entire forests until only barren ground remains.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: But it's for my cooking training, so keeping my fear at bay and controlling the temperature of the flames is also a part of my training.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's how it is... Anyway, guess it's time to go back. Arapacati is waiting for you guys!

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Yes, I'll head back to Vanarana immediately. I can't keep my precious sister worrying about me.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: As for the others... Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala are around <color=#00E1FFFF>Gandharva Ville</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Apam Woods</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Devantaka Mountain</color>.

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: #Thank you. Golden Nara {NICKNAME} is dazzling like the sun, and Paimon is quite amazing, too. I'll leave my sister's request to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why is Paimon only quite amazing!?

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Oh, don't worry about that... Anyway, I don't know how to repay you for all the help you've given me...

response.speaker: Arachatora
response.text: Hmm... I've decided to give you my Supreme Delicacy's recipe. Perhaps you'll grow fond of its taste as you age.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #({NICKNAME}, if Paimon modifies this recipe a little, it should be able to become a pretty good original dish!)

choices.text: It's a little too early for me to have something like this.

talks.objective: Neutralize the Withering Zone and pick the Head Mushroom

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: I'm so happy that I was able to gather the Head Mushroom, complete my cooking training, and get to know a strong and reliable Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #Arapacati, Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala will be grateful too. Nara {NICKNAME}, you're a good Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Grateful? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Because by helping me, you've given them a chance to taste the Head Mushroom.

talks.objective: Neutralize the Withering Zone and pick the Head Mushroom

dialogues.speaker: Head Mushroom
dialogues.text: (It does look a little larger than a normal Shroom-Kin. It's best to pick it later once the Withering Zone has been eliminated...)
